FROM [Categories] AS [c]

FROM [Categories] AS [c]
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT [p].[Id], [p].[Name], [p].[Description], [p].[Price], [p].[IsActive], [p].[CategoryId]
    FROM [Products] AS [p]

) AS [p0] ON [c].[Id] = [p0].[CategoryId]
ORDER BY [c].[Id] DESC
